notes.title: Actually, oddly satisfying: Reviews from Idle Cub, Locklear & DanField
notes.content: [p]We’ve previously been highlighted by bloggers and journalists from Germany, but thanks to Idle Cub, Locklear & DanField, the game has now captured the hearts of players in the USA, Canada, and France. We’ve gathered a few quotes from their videos to share with the community![/p][h3]・・・・・[/h3][h3][i]"This game looks so simple and everything. I don't know. It has something. It's kind of actually oddly satisfying. I could play this for a long time.”[/i] [/h3][p]—[b] [/b]Idle Cub[/p][previewyoutube="LtPF_6hM5x0;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]・・・・・ [/i][/h3][h3][i]“Sometimes games don’t need to be complicated. As long as they’re fun, that’s all we ask.”[/i] [/h3][p]— Dan Field[/p][previewyoutube="ksnVnZenm2A;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]・・・・・[/i] [/h3][h3][i]“Ricochet bullets plus piercing bullets… no way. That’s fireworks, baby!”[/i] [/h3][p]— Locklear[/p][previewyoutube="wEVaxn0Jeng;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][i]・・・・・[/i][/h3][p]If you have some spare time, you should definitely check out their channels. You might just discover your next fave creator.[/p][h3]Discovered our game through one of these videos? Drop a like and let us know! [/h3]

notes.title: "I don't know why it's so addictive…" – RangerArea on Blitzkrieg Express
notes.content: [h3]"I’ve been sitting here playing this mess for 40 minutes — I need to stop… Okay, one more round," — there’s nothing we love more than sincere feedback 😅[/h3][p]Big thanks to Pascal for this awesome review. And it looks like Blitzkrieg Express is slowly earning its place as the [b][i]weirdest tower defense[/i][/b][i] [b]game[/b][/i] out there![/p][p]Check out RangerArea’s video and let him know in the comments if you agree or not 🚂[/p][previewyoutube="QqYUDcZt-vI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Play Blitzkrieg Express in your language!
notes.content: [h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596874/8dddb585870a52e083fca54b631eed9775636d8d.png"][/img][/h3][h3]With Update 1.0.8, we’ve added localization in [b]6 more languages[/b] to help new players jump in and enjoy the ride.[/h3][p]You can switch the language anytime in the [b]in-game Settings.[/b] [/p][p]Check out the full list:[/p][list][*][p][b]🇩🇪 German [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🇫🇷 French [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🇮🇹 Italian [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🇨🇳 Chinese [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🇺🇦 Ukrainian [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]🇵🇹 Portuguese[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]We also added some minor bug fixes, including the achievements issue. [/h3][p][i]Found a translation bug or awkward phrasing? Let us know! Your feedback helps us improve the experience for everyone.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Think your tactics are genius? Prove it and win an Extra Key!

notes.title: "It’s dumb, but that’s what makes it fun" – an honest video review
notes.content: [h3]We’ve been spotted! Maxim made a whole video about our game and called Blitzkrieg Express “the weirdest tower defense game of all time.”[/h3][p]That’s one of the best pieces of feedback we’ve ever received 😄 [/p][p]If you’ve got a few minutes, check out his video and leave a comment to let him know what you think 💭[/p][previewyoutube="FojuEIX-OQM;full"][/previewyoutube]
